description: This file defines the CsvDataImportFactory class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for creating instances of data import classes, specifically for CSV data import based on the provided import type.

classes.name: CsvDataImportFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of CSV data import handlers based on the specified import type.

methods.name: getImportClassInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of PimCsvDataImport if the import type is 'pim'.
